results.reply:
Ah, my Gascons! Carbon de Castel-Jaloux and his brawlers, swaggering with their blue blood and their holes in their hats! They would sell their last sou for a song and fight the whole world before breakfast. Half of them are poor country squires with more pride than purse, and I love every one of them for it.

When De Guiche sneers at them, I see the very thing I would be myself if I were not burdened with this nose and this heart.
